items.summary: Implement a backend onboarding API that mirrors the provided PHP logic: when an authenticated user is new (no existing balance record), allocate an initial balance of 10 PKR to that user by deducting 10 PKR from the single admin wallet within the same backend call. If the admin wallet balance is less than 10 PKR, the call must fail without changing either balance and return a clear English error message (e.g., "Admin balance not enough!").

Persist the admin wallet balance and per-user balances in stable canister state so that balances are not reset after canister upgrades/redeploys (equivalent to the provided SQL example where the admin row starts at 10000 and changes persist). Add a conditional migration only if needed to preserve existing deployed state.

Add a frontend flow that calls the new onboarding API after a user signs in (Internet Identity) so new users automatically receive the initial 10 PKR allocation (when available), and returning users are not re-credited. If onboarding fails due to insufficient admin funds, show an English error toast/message and keep the displayed balances unchanged.

Add a React Query mutation/hook for the onboarding API alongside the existing wallet hooks, and ensure successful onboarding invalidates/refetches the existing balance queries so BalanceIndicator updates immediately.
